HTTP and MCP boundary: external access to shared application services
|-- [M] Backend composition: createBackend
|   |-- Chooses concrete stores, runtimes and service dependencies
|   |   |-- DiagramStore + corpus access -> core, source, diagrams and workspace services
|   |   |-- File-backed stores -> contexts, chat, change sessions, comparisons and evals
|   |   `-- Runtime selection -> fake or concrete integrations; optional language service
|   |-- Shared canvas machinery
|   |   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge wraps CanvasSessionBridge [shared bridge]
|   |   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService -> bridge, diagrams, changes, contexts, edit runtime
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService -> bridge.list() and bridge.dispatch(context)
|   |   `-- AgentChatService -> live canvas, agent tools, MCP binding and shared bridge
|   |-- Workflow dependencies
|   |   |-- PushIntegrationService -> GitPushSource + DiffSessionWorkflowService
|   |   |   `-- DiffSessionWorkflowService -> changes + agent + runtime + run store
|   |   `-- EvalRunService -> comparison sessions, workspace, contexts, prompts and outputs
|   |       |-- Agent Chat generation observer -> evalRuns.recordLegacy(...)
|   |       |-- Legacy replay/cancel -> Agent Chat
|   |       `-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog.snapshot -> evalRuns.outputSnapshot(...)
|   `-- Exposes routes, liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows, pushIntegrations and dispose()
|       `-- Route factories capture service instances; transport adapters delegate behavior
|-- [M] MCP facade: tool contracts over the backend's HTTP API
|   |-- Startup: URL argument or MAPPING_URL; optional canvas + document target
|   |   |-- Requires both target IDs together; accepts only HTTP(S) backend URLs
|   |   `-- startMappingMcpServer -> create tools -> load bound chat tools -> connect stdio
|   |-- Tool contract dependencies
|   |   |-- Domain agentToolSchemas -> registered agent tools
|   |   |-- Diagram tools -> single/batch schemas; chat binding selects direct batch schemas
|   |   `-- Bound connection -> sessionId optional in exposed schema
|   |-- [C] Agent tool invocation
|   |   |-- Resolve connection scope
|   |   |   |-- Unbound -> caller supplies session obtained through list/attach
|   |   |   |-- Canvas target, no chat binding -> lazily POST exec(canvas.attach(target))
|   |   |   |   |-- [O] Cache attachment promise per MCP server; clear on failure
|   |   |   |   `-- Inject returned sessionId into scoped calls; reject a conflicting ID
|   |   |   |       `-- Skip auto-attachment for changeSessionId or saved representation search
|   |   |   `-- Chat binding -> forward x-canvas-chat-binding
|   |   |-- Validate unbound diagram-tool arguments after resolving session
|   |   `-- POST /api/mapping/agent/tools/{name} -> shared HTTP dispatch below
|   |       |-- JSON request; 65-second fetch timeout
|   |       |-- Successful HTTP JSON -> MCP text + structuredContent.result
|   |       `-- HTTP failure or exception -> MCP isError
|   |-- [C] Additional tool-to-route translations
|   |   |-- generate-roll-up -> POST /api/mapping/evals/roll-ups
|   |   |-- read-eval-run -> GET /api/mapping/evals/runs/{runId}
|   |   |-- generate-diagram-comparisons -> POST /api/mapping/comparison-runs
|   |   |-- read-diagram-comparison-run -> GET /api/mapping/comparison-runs/{runId}
|   |   `-- list-compare-candidates -> GET /api/mapping/compare-sessions/candidates
|   `-- [C] Chat-bound tool discovery and invocation
|       |-- GET /api/mapping/agent-chat/tools with binding -> current host definitions
|       |   `-- JSON schemas -> object schemas -> register chat_{name}
|       `-- chat_{name}(input) -> POST /api/mapping/agent-chat/tools/{name}
|           `-- Body {input, callId: mcp:<requestId>} + binding -> chat.callBoundTool(...)
|-- [M] HTTP adapter: diagramApi mounts on Vite dev and preview servers
|   |-- [C] Request admission and dispatch
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next middleware
|   |   |-- Programmable agent-tool write gate
|   |   |   |-- httpEnabled != true + no binding header + mutation -> 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED
|   |   |   |-- Mutation classifier covers /api/mapping/agent/tools/* only
|   |   |   |   `-- Exempts GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and six explicitly listed POST read tools
|   |   |   `-- Workspace persistence and browser synchronization remain outside this gate
|   |   `-- /api/{namespace} -> routes.core or routes.mapping; unmatched namespace -> 404
|   |-- [M] Source and project contract: /api/core/project/*
|   |   |-- files, source -> ProjectSourceService
|   |   |-- definitions -> ensureDefinitionsEnabled() -> source.definitions(body, signal)
|   |   |   `-- [O] Response closes before completion -> abort; finally remove close listener
|   |   |-- projections -> ProjectCatalogService.saveProjection(...)
|   |   `-- corpus-compactions, representations -> catalog/CoreApplication
|   |-- [M] Canvas, persistence and change contract: /api/mapping/*
|   |   |-- agent/tools/{name} -> known schema name + POST
|   |   |   `-- String binding header -> agent.callBound(token, name, input)
|   |   |       `-- Otherwise -> agent.call(name, input)
|   |   |-- Browser agent endpoints expose fixed operations
|   |   |   |-- attachments -> generated exec(canvas.attach(validated target))
|   |   |   |-- diagram-edits, cancel -> edit-diagram / cancel-diagram-edit
|   |   |   `-- change-sessions -> list/read/preview/treemaps/accept
|   |   |       `-- Public session read omits internal receipts
|   |   |-- agent/canvases -> shared bridge register/list/unregister
|   |   |   `-- Browser GET commands -> bridge.poll; POST reply -> bridge.reply
|   |   |-- workspace -> load/save; workspace/records -> loadRecords/applyBatch
|   |   |   `-- Export and context import -> portableExport/prepareImport
|   |   |-- diagrams -> save/delete; diagrams/publish -> publishCheckpoint
|   |   `-- integrations and workflows/diff-session-create -> push and diff workflow handlers
|   |-- [M] Chat, generation and evaluation contract
|   |   |-- chat, compactions -> LocalChatService and FileCompactionService handlers
|   |   |-- prompt -> SelectionService.prepare -> run(progress callback)
|   |   |   `-- application/x-ndjson: progress records -> result record -> response.end()
|   |   |-- agent-chat -> AgentChatService sessions, turns, tools and alternative generations
|   |   |   |-- MCP origin comes from listening socket port
|   |   |   `-- Public sessions/events omit toolDefinitions, generationRequests and generation history
|   |   |-- evals -> prompts, references, snapshots, templates, experiments and judgements
|   |   |   |-- Start run / roll-up -> 202; later read/cancel/promote/output operations
|   |   |   `-- [D] GET runs/{id} response
|   |   |       |-- summarizeEvalRun(await runs.read(id)) -> summary
|   |   |       `-- summary.id -> judgements.list(id) -> include judgements only when nonempty
|   |   |-- generated-canvases -> evalRuns.generated() / migrate()
|   |   `-- compare-sessions and comparison-runs -> comparison service handlers
|   `-- Shared transport rules
|       |-- readBody -> UTF-8 JSON; empty body becomes {}; malformed JSON rejects
|       |   |-- Default limit 10 MiB; workspace payloads and canvas replies allow 64 MiB
|       |   `-- Oversized body -> discard buffered text, reject, continue draining request
|       |-- sendJson -> status + JSON content type + end
|       |-- Adapter exception before headers -> JSON error
|       |   `-- 413 size; 409 conflict; 415 binary source; 503 disabled/unavailable; otherwise 400
|       |-- Adapter exception after headers -> newline JSON error record -> end if still open
|       `-- Agent route catches its own errors
|           |-- Version/request-ID/content-hash conflict -> 409; unavailable -> 503; otherwise 400
|           `-- Oversized canvas reply -> 413; command header permits bridge error acknowledgement
|-- [M] Live transports: subscriptions and browser publishers
|   |-- [C] Agent Chat SSE: GET /api/mapping/agent-chat/sessions/{id}/events
|   |   |-- Verify session -> flush event-stream headers -> chat.subscribe(...)
|   |   |-- Public snapshot -> shorten large completed tool details
|   |   |   |-- Multiple items -> partial snapshot + one snapshot-part per item
|   |   |   `-- Full item remains available through session items endpoint
|   |   `-- [O] Route owns subscription, heartbeat and response queue
|   |       |-- 15-second heartbeat; identity encoding prevents compression delays
|   |       |-- Allow retained snapshot to drain; destroy beyond 2 MiB additional backlog
|   |       `-- Response close -> clear heartbeat + unsubscribe
|   |-- [C] WebSocket upgrade: /api/mapping/live
|   |   |-- Origin absent or Origin host equals request Host; otherwise reject with 403
|   |   |-- At 1024 clients -> reject with 503; incoming payload limit 8 MiB
|   |   `-- First validated JSON frame chooses role
|   |       |-- attach(workspaceInstanceId, documentId) -> external reader connection
|   |       |   |-- Optional initial context -> service.contextForCanvas -> service.attach
|   |       |   |-- context.get -> service.context -> context.snapshot
|   |       |   |   `-- One context request in flight; queued context blocks another
|   |       |   `-- copy/paste and agent-context.upload -> reader-scoped service operations
|   |       |       `-- Writes/uploads require their httpEnabled-derived options
|   |       `-- publish(workspaceInstanceId) -> browser publisher -> publisher.ready
|   |           `-- Selection updates/removals and copy/paste replies -> LiveCanvasService
|   |-- [D] HTTP live reads derive responses from service state
|   |   |-- live/context/short + workspace/document IDs -> short context
|   |   |   `-- Context epoch + version -> corresponding response headers
|   |   `-- live/connections/{id}/selection -> selection snapshot
|   |       |-- connectionId + sequence -> ETag
|   |       `-- ETag + If-None-Match -> 304, otherwise selection JSON + version metadata
|   `-- [O] Socket adapter owns connections, timers and transport buffering
|       |-- Bind within 10 seconds; initial context request substitutes a 30-second timeout
|       |-- Ping every 15 seconds; missed pong or socket error -> terminate
|       |-- Slow reader -> close 1013 and require reconnect for authoritative snapshot
|       |   `-- Context frames get separate queue allowance; over 64 MiB -> close 1009
|       `-- Socket close -> clear handshake, detach reader or disconnect publisher
`-- [O] Server lifetime closes the boundary
    |-- diagramApi creates one backend and attaches middleware + socket adapter
    `-- HTTP server close -> dispose sockets -> backend.dispose()
        |-- Clear socket heartbeat, remove upgrade listener, terminate clients, close socket server
        `-- Dispose comparison/eval/chat/workflow/agent services, bridge and runtimes
            `-- Dispose optional language service and compaction service too
